"""Reading-region selection tests for the Run screen.

The Run middle region shows exactly one reading at a time: the live
Activity narrative, the field Inspector, the Tools history, or Debug
(diagnostics plus graph operations). Pressing the active mode's key
returns to Activity, so the live narrative is always one keystroke away.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import cast

from textual.pilot import Pilot

from src.tui.app import SupervisorApp
from src.tui.controller.demo import DemoSessionController
from src.tui.screens.run import RunScreen
from tests.tui.conftest import RecordingSessionController

_HEIGHT: int = 40
_WIDTH: int = 140
_READING_SELECTORS: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "#agent-trace",
    "#inspector-body",
    "#tool-history",
    "#timeline",
    "#graph-ops",
)


async def _press_and_capture(key: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, bool]]:
    """Press ``key`` and return the active reading plus region visibility."""
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=RecordingSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.press(key)
        await pilot.pause()
        screen = cast(RunScreen, app.screen)
        display = {selector: app.screen.query_one(selector).display for selector in _READING_SELECTORS}
        return screen.reading_mode, display


async def _press_twice_and_capture(key: str) -> tuple[str, dict[str, bool]]:
    """Press ``key`` twice and return the resulting reading state."""
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=RecordingSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.press(key)
        await pilot.pause()
        await pilot.press(key)
        await pilot.pause()
        screen = cast(RunScreen, app.screen)
        display = {selector: app.screen.query_one(selector).display for selector in _READING_SELECTORS}
        return screen.reading_mode, display


async def _idle_visibility() -> dict[str, bool]:
    """Return reading-region visibility for a freshly mounted Run screen."""
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=DemoSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        return {
            selector: app.screen.query_one(selector).display
            for selector in _READING_SELECTORS
        }


async def test_default_reading_is_the_live_narrative() -> None:
    display = await _idle_visibility()

    assert display["#agent-trace"], "Activity is the default reading"
    for selector in ("#inspector-body", "#tool-history", "#timeline", "#graph-ops"):
        assert not display[selector], f"{selector} must stay hidden by default"


async def test_debug_stays_mounted_but_hidden_until_requested() -> None:
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=DemoSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.pause()
        timeline = app.screen.query_one("#timeline")

        assert timeline.is_mounted, "diagnostics writers need the timeline mounted"
        assert not timeline.display, "the timeline stays hidden outside Debug"


async def test_inspector_key_shows_only_the_inspector_reading() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_and_capture("i")

    assert mode == "inspector", f"i must activate the Inspector reading: {mode}"
    assert display["#inspector-body"], "the Inspector reading must be visible"
    assert not display["#agent-trace"], "Activity must yield to the Inspector reading"


async def test_tools_key_shows_the_tool_history_reading() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_and_capture("t")

    assert mode == "tools", f"t must activate the Tools reading: {mode}"
    assert display["#tool-history"], "the Tools history must be visible"
    assert not display["#agent-trace"], "Activity must yield to the Tools reading"


async def test_debug_key_shows_diagnostics_and_graph_operations() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_and_capture("d")

    assert mode == "debug", f"d must activate the Debug reading: {mode}"
    assert display["#timeline"], "Debug must reveal the diagnostics timeline"
    assert display["#graph-ops"], "Debug must reveal graph operations"


async def test_pressing_the_active_mode_key_returns_to_activity() -> None:
    mode, display = await _press_twice_and_capture("i")

    assert mode == "activity", "pressing the active mode key must return to Activity"
    assert display["#agent-trace"], "the live narrative must be visible again"
    assert not display["#inspector-body"], "the Inspector reading must close"


async def test_reading_mode_survives_projection_updates() -> None:
    app = SupervisorApp(controller=RecordingSessionController())
    async with app.run_test(size=(_WIDTH, _HEIGHT)) as pilot:
        await pilot.press("t")
        await pilot.pause()
        screen = cast(RunScreen, app.screen)
        screen.apply_projection(screen.projection)
        await pilot.pause()

        assert screen.reading_mode == "tools", (
            "a projection update must not silently change the operator's reading"
        )
        assert app.screen.query_one("#tool-history").display, (
            "the selected reading must remain visible across updates"
        )
